context: A teacher and student discuss a documentary on innovation
purpose: Teach: 岡崎/星野/ウィリアム/デイヴィッド/ゲイツ/蘭/是非とも/アタック

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 昨夜のドキュメンタリー、岡崎研究所の発展史、見応えありましたね。
lines.en: Last night's documentary on the Okazaki Institute's history — it really gave you something to sink your teeth into.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Slight pause before the dash. Genuinely interested, not performative. Inviting a response with gentle curiosity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。創設者の星野氏、若い頃の苦労、丁寧に描かれていました。
lines.en: Yes. The way they portrayed Founder Hoshino's early struggles was handled so carefully.
lines.style: Quiet admiration. Deliberate on 'carefully' — he's struck by the care. Thoughtful pace. A student recognizing craftsmanship in storytelling.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 共同研究者のウィリアム博士、デイヴィッド博士、国際チームの象徴ですね。
lines.en: Co-researchers Dr. William and Dr. David really stood out as the embodiment of that international collaboration.
lines.style: Observant, almost thinking out loud. Light emphasis on 'really' — she's noticing something worth noting. Steady, professional tone with underlying warmth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: スポンサーにゲイツ財団が入っているのも、説得力あります。
lines.en: Having the Gates Foundation as a backer — that actually strengthened the whole narrative.
lines.style: Slightly more decisive than before. Recognition of a detail that made sense. Direct but not flat. The tone of someone following logic approvingly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ラボに飾られた蘭、研究室文化の象徴でもありました。
lines.en: And those orchids in the lab — they were quite deliberate too, weren't they. Part of the whole story about the research culture.
lines.style: Softer, more reflective. Noticing a detail others might miss. Slight wonder in the delivery, like he's working through the symbolism as he speaks. Trailing slightly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 是非とも、続編の特集を期待します。
lines.en: I'm really hoping they do a follow-up. There's so much more there to explore.
lines.style: Genuine enthusiasm without overselling it. Forward-leaning but grounded. The hope of someone who wants to learn more.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 公開講座のアタックも、楽しみですね。
lines.en: And they mentioned a public lecture series coming up — that should be excellent.
lines.style: Warm, affirming close. Slight smile under the words. Eye contact level. The satisfaction of two people who've shared something good and can look forward to more.
